Covering nearly 830 acres with diverse landscapes, including wetlands and forests, these easements are valued at over $5 million, allowing farmers to maintain their operations without land development.

stories.title: Sykes refunds £2,400 cottage booking after demanding a death certificate
Wrongful Death Lawsuit: Children sue over alleged faulty vent; claims unproven
stories.summary: In a tragic turn of events, three children are pursuing a wrongful death lawsuit following the passing of their parents, John and Kristen Ruskey, due to carbon monoxide poisoning on February 8, 2026, at their seaside home. The lawsuit claims that a faulty water heater and a malfunctioning carbon monoxide detector were significant factors in their untimely deaths.

stories.title: Two brain regions tied to memory and emotion may shrink up a decade before Alzheimer’s symptoms
stories.summary: A groundbreaking study from Johns Hopkins University highlights early brain changes associated with Alzheimer's disease. Specifically, it finds that tissue loss in the entorhinal cortex and amygdala occurs years before hippocampal changes manifest. The research suggests that abnormal tau protein accumulation may play a crucial role in this deterioration. Identifying these early changes could pave the way for timely interventions, enhancing future strategies for Alzheimer's prevention and treatment.

stories.title: Woman in her 70s loses over £250,000 in cryptocurrency investment scam
'Defence, security ties key': Jaishankar ahead of India-Japan 2+2 dialogue
stories.summary: External affairs minister S Jaishankar and defence minister Rajnath Singh are in Japan for the 4th 2+2 dialogue.

stories.title: Court denies biological father parenthood rights after sexual assault finding
stories.summary: A Washington court ruled against a man's request for legal fatherhood of a child conceived through sexual assault. The ruling was based on Washington's Uniform Parentage Act, which addresses situations involving sexual violence. The child's mother provided credible evidence of ongoing abuse and intimidation from the man throughout their relationship. While the man claimed the relationship was consensual, the court found his testimony inconsistent and unconvincing.

stories.title: 1960 New Jersey home with wave-shaped roof lists for $1.65 million, studio for $995,000
stories.summary: Jules Gregory's Wave House in Lambertville has transitioned to condo status, now offering buyers the exciting option to purchase the main house, the separate studio, or both. The main residence boasts a distinctive architectural style with a generous open floor layout, while the studio presents a perfect solution for those desiring a cozy, minimalist living environment. This development allows prospective purchasers greater flexibility in selecting their ideal living arrangement.

stories.title: American couple turned a Volkswagen side hustle into a $30M hammock business
stories.summary: In 2011, Joe Demin and Rachel Connors embarked on a journey with Yellow Leaf Hammocks, originally as a side venture. Specializing in handwoven hammocks crafted by the Mlabri Tribe in Thailand, the couple faced a turning point during the pandemic. Post-Shark Tank, they pivoted to a direct-to-consumer model, empowering local women through training and crafting. Their dedication culminated in over $30 million in sales, profoundly impacting families.

stories.title: CJI averts 'potential religious row', pulls cases from SC judge
stories.summary: CJI Surya Kant withdrew two cases from the bench headed by Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah, averting a potential religious controversy.

stories.title: Can an Italian raise slogans against govt while in India on visa? SC to hear PIL
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to consider a petition concerning Italian Giacomo Filibeck's comments during a recent conference in Hyderabad. The petition claims that he breached visa terms by supporting local political matters.

stories.title: US court to Delhi courts: Help serve summons to RAW ex-chief, Doval
stories.summary: The order was issued in a civil lawsuit filed by Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, founder of pro-Khalistan outfit Sikhs for Justice (SFJ).

stories.title: GTA 6 Release: Nearly 1 in 5 US workers plan time off; 36% consider calling in sick
stories.summary: GTA 6's November 19 release has prompted workers across the United States to plan time off, with some even considering calling in sick. While Lander Allgood and Connor Folkers have arranged extended breaks to enjoy the game, others are choosing to wait until Thanksgiving. The launch has become a major event for gaming enthusiasts.

stories.title: 35 yrs on, a landmark moment: Forces kill Kashmir's last active local terrorist
stories.summary: Security forces gunned down Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Mohammad Lateef Bhat during a shootout outside a mosque in Kulgam. This incident concluded a weeklong operation to find him after the attack on a CRPF picket in Kulgam on November 11.

stories.title: Appeals Ruling: Court upholds $5,000 award; deck stays, unauthorised builds still carry costs
stories.summary: Moira and Denis Holden, a couple from Canada, constructed an unapproved wooden deck next to their cabin. They contested a demand from Valley's Edge Park Ltd. to have it taken down. The British Columbia Court of Appeal decided to uphold a $5,000 damages judgment, rather than requiring the deck's removal, as it found no notable adverse effects on the neighboring properties.

stories.title: Periodic radio bursts point to complex magnetic structure; source identity remains unresolved
stories.summary: Astronomers have made a remarkable discovery with a newly identified cosmic object, LPT J1555−5631, known for emitting intriguing radio pulses. This celestial entity produced bursts of radio waves over a span of 15 hours, then went silent for five years. Scientists are delving into its classification potential, considering various options like pulsars and magnetars, while the challenge lies in understanding its unique emission mechanisms and patterns.

stories.title: Portland architect's flower-shaped forest home lists for $2.888 million
stories.summary: A unique forest home in Portland designed by architect Robert Oshatz is now listed at $2.888 million. The property features curved ceilings and disappearing glass walls that blend living space with nature. It includes four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and multiple levels accessible by an elevator. The home is part of a larger planned collection of residences sharing forested land.

stories.title: Woman wins nearly $2.8 million after suffering burns from hot barbecue sauce
Keralam ministers question CM's key calls at cabinet meet
stories.summary: Keralam CM V D Satheesan encountered questions regarding key decisions during the cabinet meeting on Wednesday. Ministers raised concerns about appointments and representation, leading to discussions for nearly two-and-a-half hours.

stories.title: Govt hospitals to hike Ayushman packages from 23 to 112
stories.summary: Patients under Ayushman Bharat will soon have access to a broader range of medical treatments and surgical procedures. The government plans to expand packages from 23 to 112, covering various health conditions and treatments. New packages will include procedures like hysterectomy, circumcision, and diabetic-related complications. Community health centres and sub-divisional hospitals will provide these services, depending on available infrastructure and staff.

stories.title: SC starts contempt case against lawyer for remarks against CJI
stories.summary: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta, Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana directed the lawyer to file his response by January 8 and also ordered him to appear personally before it on the next date of hearing on January 20.

stories.title: Connecticut court upholds $62,530 award in employee's disability discrimination case
stories.summary: After colleagues reported a marijuana scent near her car, Latoya Council was fired from Charter Communications. Despite no evidence of her smoking or possessing marijuana at work, the ruling upheld by the Appellate Court pointed to bias against her PTSD condition. Following a protracted legal struggle, she secured compensation for her unjust termination, emphasizing the ongoing conflict between workplace regulations and the rights of those with disabilities.

stories.title: Psychology says a few minutes of your speech may reveal how fast your brain is aging
stories.summary: A groundbreaking speech clock has been developed by researchers to evaluate speech patterns and estimate biological age. This innovative tool highlights the potential relationship between speech traits and cognitive decline, including dementia. Involving nearly 3,000 Spanish-speaking participants from various Latin American nations, the results suggest that noticeable differences in speech age may signal cognitive difficulties. Future research is essential to further explore the role of speech analysis in cognitive evaluations.

stories.title: Jeff Bridges leads US child-hunger campaign targeting 10 million children by 2032
stories.summary: Jeff Bridges is spearheading the Amplify Impact campaign aimed at eradicating child hunger across America. This ambitious initiative seeks to support 10 million children by 2032, highlighting innovative local solutions to the hunger crisis. Backed by a substantial $5 million in grants from No Kid Hungry, the campaign will fortify nutrition programs to ensure that every child has access to wholesome meals.

stories.title: Idaho dropped 76 beavers from aeroplanes in parachute-equipped boxes in 1948
US man accused of plotting foiled Hindu temple shooting in Illinois faces new charges
stories.summary: Alexandros Paporakis, a 19-year-old resident of Palatine, faces severe charges including terrorism and armed violence after allegedly planning a mass shooting targeting a Hindu temple during the Navaratri festival. Reports from his co-workers contributed to his arrest, during which law enforcement discovered weapons and extremist propaganda. This incident has raised alarms within the Hindu community about escalating hate crimes.

stories.title: Palm Beach mansion linked to $194m CIA fraud sells for $24m after government seizure
stories.summary: In a stunning development, a lavish mansion in Palm Beach, Florida, has changed hands for $24 million. This opulent property was acquired using funds siphoned from a substantial government fraud scheme, orchestrated by the previous owner, David T. Nichols, who confessed to embezzling nearly $194 million. Following his conviction, authorities seized the estate, and the proceeds from this sale will aid in recovering the losses stemming from this extensive fraud.

stories.title: Broker ordered to pay $1.3M over banned expansion on $1.41M Nantucket cottage
stories.summary: In Nantucket, Dr. Mary Murray and attorney Jeffrey Ment faced unexpected challenges after purchasing a cottage with expansion aspirations. Legal barriers led to a prolonged court case, but justice prevailed, and they were awarded roughly $1.3 million in damages. Nevertheless, the couple encountered financial difficulties and sold the property at a loss before upgrading to a larger home in a thriving market, now contending with considerable debt.

stories.title: Idris Elba and wife plan 40,000-person eco-city on Sierra Leone's Sherbro Island
Sydney builder ordered to pay $346,000 over 127 defects found in two homes
Canadian judge rejects son's inheritance claim but orders family firms to disclose financial records
stories.summary: In a recent legal dispute, a son faced a setback in his claims over family companies and property ownership. He believed his shareholder status gave him rights to specific assets within those firms. However, the court clarified that his view of shareholder entitlements was flawed, emphasizing that his rights pertained only to his investment. While his oppression claim was dismissed, he was permitted access to the company's financial documentation.

stories.title: Texas homeowners secure $1.9 million settlement and protections over nearby data centre project
stories.summary: Homeowners in Westlake, Texas, have come to an agreement concerning a proposed data centre that had sparked concerns. The settlement includes a financial contribution from developer PowerHouse earmarked for noise reduction and fire safety measures. Furthermore, the project will adhere to specific operational limits and environmental safeguards to alleviate resident anxieties. Though this venture promises to enhance Westlake's revenue significantly, community opinions remain split regarding the development.

stories.title: Pennsylvania landowner's 4540 acre forest protected from subdivision, preserving public recreation access
stories.summary: The Western Pennsylvania Conservancy has notably secured a vital conservation easement for a sprawling 4,540-acre forest in Pennsylvania. This landmark agreement ensures the land is preserved from any future development, safeguarding its natural elements. Since its establishment in 1932, the organization has protected over 300,000 acres, emphasizing critical wildlife habitats and advocating for sustainable forestry. This initiative highlights the critical role of conservation efforts in the region's ecological future.

stories.title: Cat Reunited With Family: Rescuers find Isaac alive; he hid in a kitchen cabinet
stories.summary: In a heartwarming turn of events, 13-year-old Zariah Coleman was joyously reunited with her beloved cat, Isaac, four days after a devastating building collapse that claimed eight lives. Amid the wreckage, rescue teams from various organizations banded together, ultimately finding Isaac snugly tucked away in a kitchen cabinet. Despite the chaos, the reunion brought a precious moment of happiness for Zariah and her mother.

stories.title: India to add 75,000 medical seats by 2029, says health minister J P Nadda
Historic first: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries nominated to become House Speaker
Private bikes, delivery services can generate 18 cr jobs: Gadkari
In 1997, Princess Diana stayed at Cape Town’s Tarrystone Estate, now listed for R150 million
stories.summary: Tarrystone Estate in Cape Town, once the South African home of Princess Diana’s younger brother, Charles Spencer, is now on the market for R150 million. Diana stayed at the property during her March 1997 visit to South Africa, just months before her death. The cottage where she stayed has been preserved on the sprawling estate.

stories.title: Punjab assembly polls: Congress likely to release first list of candidates in 10-15 days
Court lets New Hampshire homeowners pursue group trespass claim over chemical water pollution
stories.summary: A federal appeals court has permitted New Hampshire homeowners to advance a class-action trespass claim against Saint-Gobain. However, the court denied group treatment for negligence and failure-to-warn claims due to individual property assessments. Contamination of drinking water due to PFOA emissions from a manufacturing plant has been identified. The ruling acknowledged the homeowners' right to seek compensation while leaving individual claims to be determined later.

stories.title: Amit Shah to inaugurate NIA anti-terror conference on cross-border terrorism
'Suffering because of that': Moily says certain Congress leaders stalled probe against Modi during UPA regime
'Balasaheb like a deity to us': Eknath Shinde defends Shaina NC in photo row, says she has clarified
Virginia court settles family dispute over Smith Mountain Lake home and inherited ownership shares
stories.summary: A legal conflict concerning a Virginia lakeside property has escalated to the state's Court of Appeals. The court determined that Joan Cabaniss holds a 50% ownership share, while her late husband's children retain the remaining half through his will. Disputes over inheritance and property rights, including a contested quitclaim deed from one child, have been addressed.

stories.title: Rare 1911 Denver Mint gold coin found in family safe-deposit box could fetch $500,000+
stories.summary: A remarkable discovery has surfaced—a $10 gold coin from 1911 that was hidden away in a family safe deposit box. Graded PCGS MS 65 and sanctioned by Certified Acceptance Corporation, this rare find is projected to sell for over $500,000 at an auction in January 2027. With only about 1,650 known examples in existence, such rare items often remain undetected until expert grading brings them into the spotlight.

stories.title: 'Addiction to being in spotlight': BJP says Rahul 'defames' India to grab headlines amid row over his remarks in US
Missouri couple win $47,500 after former sellers block property sale over a paid-off mortgage
stories.summary: In a challenging situation, a couple in Missouri struggled to sell their home when previous sellers refused to acknowledge a cleared mortgage. This conflict prompted a court's decision to award them $47,500 in damages after evidence confirmed the mortgage was paid off. The ruling also covered legal fees, underscoring the critical need for transparent financial protocols in real estate dealings.

stories.title: UNICEF and IAP launch ‘Child Rights Pledge Platform’ to make pediatricians voice for wellbeing of children
Tom Holland and Zendaya buy £8.25 million London mansion at £750,000 discount
stories.summary: Tom Holland and Zendaya have reportedly purchased an £8.25 million mansion in London, paying £750,000 below its asking price. The five-bedroom property spans over 5,000 square feet and sits on an acre of land. The reported cash purchase adds another impressive real estate investment to the couple’s growing property portfolio.

stories.title: 'Look forward to strengthen India-UK ties': PM Modi shares pictures after meeting Prince William, Kate Middleton
Punjab CM Mann seeks MEA permission to visit Kartarpur Sahib in Pakistan
Hindu population growth to fall behind other religions in India, globally: Pew Study
Gujarat farmers seek next-gen GM crops, call for science-led policy on farm technology
US deports Khalistan supporter linked to Punjab railway blast, held in Delhi
PM Modi chairs council of ministers meet; end of Naxalism, world bank report on poverty discussed
Before the first bullet: Army rescued 27 from seminary, then hunted LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat
Evening news wrap: Xi hosts Trump ahead of trilateral meeting with Putin; Sena vs Sena row over Bal Thackeray's photo & more
Bangladesh ready to work with India to trace missing Assam woman
'A lot of it is connected': Rahul Gandhi links India, France, US to global economic shifts
Woman denied medical insurance claim after breast cancer diagnosis
stories.summary: Jeanette Mozuch bought a cancer policy from Heartland National Life Insurance for extra coverage. After being diagnosed with breast cancer, she filed a claim expecting support for her medical expenses. Heartland denied her claim, stating she answered a question incorrectly on her application regarding mammograms. Mozuch plans to appeal the denial while questioning if other policyholders faced similar issues.

stories.title: 'Disaster in his mind': BJP hits back at Rahul Gandhi over 'economic crisis' remark
North Carolina father sues HOA over $70,000 Christmas display with 60,000 lights
stories.summary: Neil Heuer's dazzling Christmas light display in North Carolina, costing over $70,000, has become a beloved holiday attraction. However, this festive spectacle has drawn ire from his homeowners association, which claims it's causing traffic issues. They are proposing new rules to limit decorations and have begun enforcement actions. Undeterred, Heuer plans to maintain his enchanting display despite the legal pushback.

stories.title: Ring Returned After 47 Years: Detectorist reunites Benson with brother; school names him honorary member
stories.summary: In a touching story of lost and found, metal detector enthusiast Lucas Thrun returned a class ring to Paul Benson, who had lost it 47 years ago during his brother’s visit to Washington in 1979. After discovering the ring in November 2025, Thrun meticulously pieced together clues to locate Benson. This gesture not only reconnected him with his long-lost possession but also sparked a heartwarming family reunion. St.

stories.title: Beyond marks: CISCE launches nationwide test to spot learning gaps
stories.summary: Mandatory digital assessment for Classes IV, VI and IX records over 30 lakh responses in 48 hours; schools to get insights into students’ learning needs

stories.title: Morris Brown alumni donate $700,000 to restore historic 1882 campus landmark
A year after picking up the gun: The end of Kashmir’s last known active LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat
stories.summary: Mohammad Lateef Bhat, a wanted terrorist involved in multiple attacks, was killed in Kulgam after an extensive operation. Security forces had been searching for him and his associate following a series of violent incidents. The operation included attempts to persuade Bhat to surrender, which he refused. He was located in a mosque where he opened fire on security personnel.

stories.title: Indiana father on disability ordered to sell $270,000 home; court overturns college fee order
stories.summary: An Indiana appeals court has decided on a divorce settlement case involving an Indiana man and his former wife. The court ordered the sale of their $270,000 marital home while considering the father's financial situation. It reversed the decision requiring him to contribute to his daughter's college expenses due to his limited income. The appeals court directed adjustments to how parental contributions to optional activities should be split.

stories.title: Woman reclaimed her repossessed car, but police treated it as stolen
Air India crash: Centre says investigation at 'fag end'; report still awaited
'Should be publicly flogged': Sena vs Sena escalates after Shaina NC 'tears' Balasaheb's photo
9 in 10 Indian firms hit by AI agents in past year; only a third contained it within a day: Survey
stories.summary: In a recent survey, an alarming 92% of Indian organizations reported security incidents involving AI agents. A mere 36% were able to resolve these incidents within 24 hours, exposing governance weaknesses. While 51% had automated systems to detect unusual behavior, 67% lacked automatic response capabilities. Moreover, 37% found unregistered AI agents in their systems in the past year.

stories.title: Three women stranded by US flight shutdown buy $48,000 Ford Bronco and drive 27 hours home
stories.summary: When three women found themselves stranded in North Carolina amidst widespread flight cancellations, they explored various transport options without success. Finally, they opted to purchase a new Ford Bronco and embarked on a near 1,500-mile journey to Bismarck, taking around 27 hours. The drive fostered a strong bond between them, and although initially considering selling the Bronco, they've decided to keep it, cherishing their impromptu adventure.

stories.title: 'Purity of voter list': Yogi Adityanath defends SIR after 'missing' Hindu voters claim
stories.summary: Yogi Adityanath has staunchly defended the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, emphasizing its role in maintaining the integrity of voter lists. He highlighted the necessity of removing deceased individuals and non-citizens from the rolls. With the upcoming assembly elections on the horizon, Adityanath expressed firm confidence in the BJP's ability to secure victory.

stories.title: Greenpeace activists dumped boulders into the sea, which hindered with a £12 billion project
stories.summary: Greenpeace activists have strategically placed boulders on the seabed to shield crucial marine ecosystems from the threats of industrial fishing. However, this maneuver poses challenges for the Norfolk Vanguard offshore windfarm project. The boulders infringe upon the designated development zone, prompting discussions on environmental management. Although the windfarm promises to deliver substantial renewable energy and job creation, developers are currently reviewing the implications amid Greenpeace's call for enhanced marine protection.

stories.title: Scientists in South Africa have named a new dinosaur whose young already weighed about 400 kg
stories.summary: A groundbreaking discovery in South Africa has unveiled a new dinosaur species named Nyana rooiwalensis. This juvenile, weighing approximately 400 kilograms at just three years old, shows signs of rapid growth through bone analysis. Nyana is categorized among sauropodomorphs, the ancestors of the gigantic dinosaurs we know today. This finding provides vital insights into the evolutionary journey and growth dynamics of early dinosaurs.

stories.title: Texas appeals court modifies divorce settlement, cuts ex-wife's $92,426 award to $18,369
stories.summary: A Texas appeals court has taken action to reduce the financial settlement granted to Sarah Kawinzi in her divorce case against Charles Murungi. After reviewing the case, the court ruled that the initial award surpassed her rightful entitlement as per the settlement agreement.

stories.title: Arnold bought his former army tank, later crushing a car in Netflix stunt
18-y-o pilot Rose Donald flies 15,000km solo, raising $80,000 for sick children
stories.summary: In an inspiring feat, 18-year-old Rose Donald from Melbourne completed a stunning 40-day solo journey flying around Australia. Covering roughly 15,000 kilometers and spending 100 hours airborne, she raised about $80,000 for the charity Little Wings, which aids children battling severe illnesses. Balancing her schoolwork, Rose completed her flight in 25 legs. With aspirations in aviation, she is enhancing her flying skills and boosting her confidence.

stories.title: WV woman wins damages after laptop data loss and 18-month company default

In 2005, Seattle began restoring neglected urban forests with volunteers; two decades later, 1.5 million native plants have been planted, and more than 2,000 acres are under restoration, earning a UN honour
stories.summary: Volunteers in Seattle have revived urban forests through collective efforts and consistent maintenance over two decades. The Green Seattle Partnership, launched in 2005, has successfully engaged thousands of residents in restoration activities. More than 1.5 million native plants have been introduced, including over 355,000 trees, enhancing local ecosystems. This initiative has received recognition by the United Nations as a World Restoration Flagship for community-driven efforts.

stories.title: Ex-White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt urges Trump team to address US tech outages
Pan-Mass Challenge raises record $80 million, bringing cancer donations to $1.2 billion+
stories.summary: In a groundbreaking announcement, the Pan-Mass Challenge revealed an unprecedented donation of $80 million to the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute this November. This remarkable achievement not only exceeds their 2026 fundraising target by $1 million but also highlights the organization's extensive contributions, totaling over $1.2 billion for cancer research since 1980.

stories.title: Florida man fined $180 for grabbing python in Everglades has citation dropped
SC issues notice to Congress, AAP, AISA over traders' plea against Delhi protests
Trump pushes ban on Chinese AI data center gear despite tech giants' pushback
stories.summary: In the midst of escalating tensions, the Trump administration is poised to restrict imports of Chinese optical transceivers essential for AI data centers. Tech giants warn that such a shift could lead to a decade-long replacement process due to existing market constraints. Concurrently, China advocates for the removal of semiconductor technology limitations, stating that these hinder the market potential of its companies.

stories.title: 'B team of SP, Congress': CM Yogi targets Owaisi-Chandrashekhar alliance ahead of UP polls
stories.summary: In a recent statement, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath condemned the collaboration between AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Aazad, labeling it as a secondary faction for the Samajwadi Party and Congress. As both leaders gear up for the upcoming 2027 Assembly elections, they aim to challenge the BJP's grip on power.

stories.title: Dakota apartment owned by Tribeca Film Festival founders sells after price cut
stories.summary: After nearly ten years of trying to sell their apartment at the Dakota, the couple has finally found a buyer. The apartment was initially listed at $39 million but was later reduced to $12.5 million. Located on Central Park, the spacious unit spans about 6,000 square feet, offering stunning views of the park. The sale comes after significant price cuts and complex negotiations between the former couple.

stories.title: NCBS researcher from Bengaluru wins Google PhD Fellowship
'Whitewashing history': Shiv Sena Shinde faction leaders tear up a copy of Sonia Gandhi's memoir
'Lateef killed': Forces celebrate in Kulgam as Kashmir’s last known active local terrorist falls
'Youth must know what UP was like 10 years ago': CM Yogi renews 'batenge toh katenge' pitch
stories.summary: Yogi Adityanath defended his slogans at the News18 Rising Bharat Summit, emphasizing awareness of Uttar Pradesh's historical issues. He highlighted past governance failures, including riots and insecurity, under the Samajwadi Party. Adityanath claimed the state is now safer and riot-free under BJP leadership. He reiterated that security, nationalism, and cultural nationalism would be central themes in upcoming elections.

stories.title: Saffron saree row: West Bengal government to probe claim Kolkata school questioned teacher's dress choice
stories.summary: West Bengal education minister Dipak Barman is set to investigate allegations regarding a teacher's attire at a missionary school. The charges claim a colleague questioned the teacher for wearing saffron sarees, alleging a dress code violation. Chief minister Suvendu Adhikari indicated potential actions against individuals or the institution if complaints are verified. BJP's Samik Bhattacharya also raised concerns about possible religious conversions at such institutions.

stories.title: SC to hear PIL against Italian politician’s ‘Vote Chor’ remarks at Bharat Summit
J&K: Kulgam attack mastermind Lateef Bhat killed after week-long operation
stories.summary: In a significant operation, security forces eliminated Mohammad Lateef Bhat in Kulgam after a series of strategic maneuvers lasting a week. Earlier, his associate, Umar Nisar Dar, was taken down in a separate encounter. Lateef had wounded three CRPF personnel during a recent attack and had evaded capture since then. The authorities reiterated their strong stance against further terrorist activities in the region.

stories.title: Wrongful Death Settlement: Brown family secures $5 million; claims against Walgreens remain pending
stories.summary: The family of Banko Brown, a Black transgender man fatally shot by a security guard, has secured a $5 million settlement related to claims against the guard and his employer. However, the legal battle continues, as the family's lawsuit against Walgreens and Allied Universal Security Services remains unresolved in court.

stories.title: Plea alleges Sonia Gandhi used forged papers for 1980 voter entry; court seeks police report
stories.summary: The Rouse Avenue Court has instructed the officer in charge of the IP Estate Police Station to prepare an Action Taken Report regarding a complaint that alleges Sonia Gandhi’s name was on electoral rolls before she was granted Indian citizenship. During proceedings, the advocate presented electoral roll records from 1980 to 1983.

stories.title: SCBA urges Supreme Court to initiate criminal contempt proceedings against advocate
'Heavens will not fall': SC on ED plea challenging Azam Khan's interim bail
Unvaccinated yellow fever-risk travellers may face six-day quarantine; new airport rules propose changes
stories.summary: India has unveiled draft regulations enhancing quarantine protocols for travelers from yellow fever-affected nations. Unvaccinated arrivals could face quarantine of up to six days at their own expense. Airlines will be responsible for transporting non-compliant passengers to designated facilities. Furthermore, new reporting standards concerning passenger health and travel information will be established for airlines. The health ministry is collecting feedback from all stakeholders on these proposed measures before finalization.

stories.title: Man allegedly used axe, chemicals to destroy $60 million US military aircraft
stories.summary: A 48-year-old Irish man has been charged with damaging a $60 million military aircraft at Shannon Airport. Daithi O'Corrain allegedly broke into a US Air National Guard plane and caused extensive damage. He reportedly planned the attack for several months before executing it and was arrested at the scene. The aircraft will not return to active flying status due to the severity of the damage.

stories.title: US lawmakers seek probe into disruption of Seattle Diwali event over racist signs
stories.summary: US lawmakers have sought a federal probe into the disruption of a Diwali celebration in Seattle by protesters carrying racist signs targeting Indian Americans. The lawmakers alleged the incident reflected growing anti-South Asian hate and urged the Department of Justice to prioritise hate crime investigations. The disruption involved far-right activist Jake Lang and others carrying placards reading "Deport All Dot Heads".

stories.title: Vermont Supreme Court upholds $15,100 extortion, $7,500 contract and $5,000 assault awards
stories.summary: A property transaction in Vermont escalated into a legal fracas due to incomplete work and financial disputes. The Vermont Supreme Court backed multiple awards for civil extortion, breach of contract, and assault. The conflict originated from a pond construction project, which sparked disagreements regarding payments and access to the property. Despite both sides requesting attorney's fees, these were denied in light of the trial court's findings.

stories.title: Rubio says there is ‘zero’ evidence linking US outages to cyberattacks
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is no evidence linking recent outages to malicious activities. The disruptions have affected various sectors, including aviation and banking services. Companies and agencies attributed these issues to technical problems and maintenance activities. Critics are calling for more transparency regarding the incidents and their causes. Officials have emphasized the need for upgrading aging computer systems to prevent similar disruptions.

stories.title: SC to hear INDIA bloc's poser plea on CEC on Dec 9
stories.summary: Senior advocates Kapil Sibal and AM Singhvi urged the Supreme Court to issue notices regarding the interrogatory. The bench, led by Chief Justice Surya Kant, opted to adjourn the hearing until December 9. The opposition bloc seeks clarity on decisions made by the Election Commission in their joint petition. They referenced irregularities and the need for eligible voter inclusion in electoral rolls.

stories.title: 'Sitting on disaster': Rahul flags 'economic crisis' in India during US visit; BJP hits back
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi warned of an impending economic crisis in India, citing unemployment and concerns over the education system during an event at Columbia University in New York. He said India's youth were increasingly frustrated as they saw no future for themselves, pointing to a growing disconnect with their parents over career opportunities. The Congress leader is on a two-day US visit.

stories.title: SC to Chhattisgarh: Pay Rs 30 lakh to man for illegal detention
'Again, I wasn't heard': Bilkis to fight SC order giving bail to 2 convicts
stories.summary: The Supreme Court suspended the life sentences of and granted bail to two of 11 men convicted of gang-raping her and killing 14 of her family in the 2002 Gujarat riots.

stories.title: Pakistani man gets 27 years in US jail for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
stories.summary: A Pakistani man, Asif Merchant, was sentenced to 330 months in prison in the US for plotting to assassinate President Donald Trump and other prominent politicians at Iran's behest in 2024. Prosecutors said the plot was planned in retaliation for the 2020 killing of Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani. Merchant was convicted in March, while the plot was foiled before any attack took place.

stories.title: Jennifer Lopez unveils renovated $17.5m California estate after her divorce

stories.summary: The Supreme Court refused to entertain a petition challenging the government's 2025 amendment to Zilla Parishads and Panchayat Samitis Act, 1961.

stories.title: Amid China rivalry, India joins move to shield AI tech chain
stories.summary: The San Francisco Declaration reinforces the importance of coordinated efforts to address economic coercion, supply chain disruptions, non-market policies and their market-distorting effects.

stories.title: Canadian farmer fined $213,000 for cutting neighbour's trees and filling a ditch
Govt plans to set up visual library of stolen artefacts, deploy AI for verification
stories.summary: The ministry of culture plans to give shape to a provenance mission for antiquities wherein an artifact's ownership and collection history is traced back to its place of origin.

stories.title: Dancing girl of Mohenjo-Daro to find new home in North Block museum next year
stories.summary: Several objects are likely to be moved from the National Museum to the ‘Adornment’ gallery. Visitors will be able to see ancient gold and gem-studded jewellery from Taxila (Taksasila) currently placed at the National Museum.

stories.title: Illinois appeals court upholds $7.5 million award in baby's childbirth death malpractice case
stories.summary: In a significant ruling, an Illinois appeals court upheld a $7.5 million wrongful-death verdict for the Flores family, stemming from medical negligence during childbirth at Advocate Illinois Masonic Medical Center. The court confirmed that juror consensus on negligence and its consequences was sufficient, thus clarifying standards in medical negligence cases. This judgement offers solace to the Flores family and underscores the critical need for prompt medical care.

stories.title: Dorit Kemsley ordered to sell $7 million mansion amid divorce battle
Microsoft asked him to go back to India after his H-1B visa was rejected. Kunal Bahl returned, but to build Snapdeal, Titan Capital
Brandi Carlile's charity surpasses $10m in grants, earning 2026 award recognition for its impact
stories.summary: At the 2026 Anthem Awards, Brandi Carlile shines as the Entertainer of the Year, celebrating a remarkable achievement for her Looking Out Foundation, which recently surpassed $10 million in grants to diverse charitable organizations. With a focus on uplifting LGBTQIA2S+ communities, the foundation inspires fans to donate small amounts, emphasizing that even an average contribution of $25 can create significant change.

stories.title: California's Shiv Durga Hindu temple reports another break-in; Republican leader tells Ro Khanna: It's your constituency...what are you doing?
Michigan woman revives $1 million lawsuit over unpaid divorce settlement after ex-husband's death
stories.summary: Jamie Lee Baker is taking legal action against attorney Michael A. Robbins, alleging malpractice following her ex-husband's death. She contends that the divorce settlement left her financially vulnerable, receiving inadequate payments and facing issues with collateral. Recently, the Michigan Court of Appeals has reopened her case for further examination, shedding light on the intricate nature of divorce settlements, particularly those involving business interests.

stories.title: Oprah joins Australian charity drive, packing care bag as campaign targets 150,000 donations
stories.summary: Oprah Winfrey is lending her support to Share the Dignity’s charity initiative by assembling care bags for women in need. This campaign, which runs from November 6 to November 22, 2026, across Australia, aims to gather 150,000 bags filled with essential items and uplifting notes. These care bags will benefit women struggling with homelessness or domestic violence. Donations are accepted at various Bunnings stores or online throughout the campaign duration.

stories.title: Two live snakes found inside passenger's suitcase at California airport: 'When I realized the item in my hand was alive...'
US returns 337 looted antiquities to Italy, including stolen Alexander bust
Woman seeks half of £6m mansion after living with millionaire for 45 years
UK man wins Argos laptop refund battle after court rules activating Windows 11 does not cancel rights
stories.summary: A landmark court decision has established that buyers can return items purchased online within 14 days of receiving them. A University of Leicester professor successfully challenged retail titan Argos over the return of a laptop. The Court of Appeal ruled that activating pre-installed software does not forfeit the right to a refund. This ruling enhances consumer protection for electronics in the UK, prompting retailers to rethink their return policies.

stories.title: US stalker ordered to pay $18.6 million after stealing woman's Verizon records with fake warrant
stories.summary: In a landmark ruling, a federal judge in North Carolina has ordered convicted stalker Robert Michael Glauner to pay $18.632 million to a victim for the emotional trauma inflicted upon her. This judgment, which includes punitive damages, stems from Glauner's harassment after he unlawfully procured her private information with a forged search warrant. He was apprehended while attempting to confront her and remains incarcerated.

stories.title: Ohio Appeals Court upholds $13,013 award against landlords over couple's belongings
NBA star Baron Davis seeks dismissal of sister's California home lawsuit
'Spent lakhs on a US master's, graduated with a 3.9 GPA, and still had to return to India': 26-year-old man earning Rs 9LPA asks, 'Did I not try hard enough'
California woman sells her $350,000 home in AI Steve Burton romance scam
'No money left': French far-right leader vows to cut off Ukraine aid if elected prez
Trump met Jon Voight at White House as US flight shutdown stranded thousands
Trump hints at meeting Kim Jong Un in China, says Xi could play role

Indian inventor patents new technique to transmute elements, reports gold in tests
Congress forms screening committees for 5 poll-bound states; Ajay Maken to head UP panel
Covert Cafe: NCB busts secret basement Meow Meow lab in Ahmedabad
Census 2027: Self-enumeration begins in four states, house-to-house count from December 1
stories.summary: The Census 2027 self-enumeration process has commenced in Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Goa, and Uttarakhand, running until November 30. Following this, house-to-house enumeration will begin on December 1. The initiative aims to gather a range of data, including caste details from respondents, with an open-ended approach. Meanwhile, Manipur's census has been postponed due to local concerns regarding the national register of citizens.

stories.title: IISc researchers find antibiotic combination to reverse drug resistance in TB
'I felt accepted': Sonia Gandhi revisits 2004 Cong win, opens up at memoir launch
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir release shed light on her journey of acceptance in India post the 2004 Congress victory. She shared her early experiences with Indira Gandhi, detailing feelings of both intimidation and admiration over time. Following the tragic assassination of Rajiv Gandhi, her children emerged as pillars of emotional strength. Sonia's message to the youth emphasizes the importance of participating in politics and civic life.

stories.title: A decade out of power: Why Congress is struggling to make a comeback in Uttarakhand
Intimidatory speech case: Abhishek Banerjee seeks extension of protection; Calcutta HC to hear plea on Nov 20
'520 drains discharge wastewater in the Yamuna': SC raps admin over rising pollution despite huge spending
Evening news wrap: Terrorist killed in J&K Kulgam encounter; SC grants bail to 2 Bilkis Bano case convicts & more
'No one excluded': CM Yogi Adityanath says Census 2027 will ensure welfare benefits for all
stories.summary: In a significant move for Census 2027, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has initiated the self-enumeration process in Lucknow. Emphasizing the importance of precise data for identifying individuals missing from welfare initiatives, he outlined how this census will collect vital demographic details to inform the development of crucial infrastructure such as health centers and schools.

stories.title: 'Dalit oppression, land grab': BJP hits back at Akhilesh over 'Damdar Dalit' remarks
stories.summary: In response to Akhilesh Yadav's recent appeal to the Dalit community, BJP leaders have launched a series of critiques against the Samajwadi Party chief. They pointed out the SP's past failures regarding Dalit issues during its tenure, with Uttar Pradesh MSME minister Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary highlighting various incidents of Dalit oppression.

stories.title: Ajit Pawar plane crash: Maharashtra CM urges Amit Shah to fast-track probe, release early report
Union minister Suresh Gopi says diesel, price cuts 'not possible right away'; cites Rs 42,000 crore losses
stories.summary: Union Minister Suresh Gopi highlighted the challenges posed by Rs 42,000 crore losses in the oil sector, stating that lowering fuel prices is currently impractical. While consumers are eager for cuts, he noted that immediate adjustments are not feasible. Furthermore, he encouraged state governments to ease tax burdens on petrol.

stories.title: 'Who ordered SIR?' Congress seeks SC nod to pose 48 questions to EC, CEC Gyanesh Kumar over 'vote chori'
stories.summary: In a significant move, Congress has voiced its apprehensions over the Election Commission of India's affidavit to the Supreme Court. They emphasize that their pressing inquiries into purported electoral roll irregularities remain largely unaddressed. The party has compiled a list of 48 detailed questions for the Election Commission, focusing on aspects such as the Special Intensive Revision process.

stories.title: Ukraine launches biggest drone attack on Russia; Moscow says over 1,300 drones intercepted
stories.summary: Amid rising tensions, Russia disclosed that it thwarted more than 1,300 drone assaults from Ukraine during a blitz on Monday. The Ukrainian military has ramped up its drone operations, specifically aiming at vital oil infrastructure in Russia. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy emphasized the detrimental effect of these strikes on Russia's oil production. However, despite attempts at US-mediated negotiations, the situation remains unresolved and precarious.

stories.title: Cape Verde president re-elected with 64% of votes, defeats first-ever woman candidate
Ben Wallace lists sprawling Virginia mansion for $6.9M
stories.summary: Ben Wallace has listed his Goochland County mansion for sale at an asking price of $6.9 million. The mansion spans 35 acres and features over 22,000 square feet of living space. It includes six bedrooms, an indoor sports court, and a chef's kitchen with high-end appliances. Wallace previously sold his indoor basketball facility in Henrico and is shifting his real estate investments.

stories.title: Parents fled Mozambique with unregistered newborn; 26 yrs later, Gujarat woman gets Indian passport
stories.summary: Dolly Vadalia, originally from Mozambique, encountered significant obstacles in her quest for Indian citizenship due to a lack of documentation. After her marriage in 2023, multiple attempts to secure her passport were denied due to her parents' failure to register her birth. However, the Indian embassy stepped in to ensure her birth was recorded, and on November 11, she finally obtained her Indian passport.

stories.title: 'When CM was unavailable, Ajit Pawar was there': Amit Shah remembers ex-Maharashtra deputy CM
stories.summary: During a significant bust unveiling event, Amit Shah shared heartfelt condolences on the untimely passing of Ajit Pawar. He acknowledged Pawar’s impactful contributions, especially during the challenging Covid-19 pandemic, contrasting his proactive approach with prior government communication challenges. Meanwhile, Maharashtra’s Chief Minister, Devendra Fadnavis, urgently called for the swift release of the investigation report into the tragic plane crash that took Ajit Pawar's life on January 28.

stories.title: 15-year-old Abuja student wins ₦15m grant in national essay competition
stories.summary: Fifteen-year-old Khaira Ojima Bala has triumphed in the UBA Foundation National Essay Competition, outshining over 15,000 competitors from secondary schools nationwide. Her insightful essay tackled the themes of food security and national development, urging her peers to contemplate critical societal challenges. As a reward for her exceptional work, Bala is awarded a ₦15 million scholarship for her university education.

stories.title: Faster shift to electricity can save India Rs 9.6 lakh crore in fuel imports annually by FY35: Study
From fighting fires to building a $225 million startup: How a 27-year-old left Goldman Sachs to give old fire trucks a new life
stories.summary: Garage, an innovative marketplace created by Martin Hunt, specializes in used fire department equipment, connecting buyers to much-needed surplus emergency vehicles. Recently securing $41 million in Series B funding, Garage's valuation has skyrocketed as it now serves over 1,000 communities across the U.S. and Canada, with plans to expand into public works and sanitation equipment markets.

stories.title: J&K: Lashkar terrorist killed in Kulgam encounter days after attack on CRPF personnel
UN chief hopes Trump-Xi-Putin meeting will lead to nuclear disarmament efforts
stories.summary: The United Nations is ready to engage in nuclear disarmament discussions between the United States, China, and Russia. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres emphasized the need for cautious optimism regarding potential agreements. US President Donald Trump plans to raise arms reduction efforts during the upcoming meeting of world leaders. China perceives this trilateral meeting as vital for global peace and stability.

stories.title: She felt alone as a Black woman in tech; after 22 years in the industry, Pearl Oguchi has built a 50,000-member community
stories.summary: Through her own experiences in technology, Pearl Oguchi uncovered the challenges Black women face in their careers, identifying a significant absence of support. In response, she created Black Women in Tech, a flourishing community that has grown to include more than 50,000 members. This platform provides essential resources such as job referrals and CV reviews while fostering mentorship.

stories.title: NYC landlord seeks $550K from tenant accused of harassing 3 families
stories.summary: A Manhattan landlord has filed a $550,000 lawsuit against a 72-year-old tenant accused of harassing three families who lived in the apartment above hers. The latest family, with three children, alleged repeated threats, abusive shouting and police calls. A judge has issued a temporary restraining order. The landlord also claims the tenant owes nearly $88,000 in rent.

stories.title: 74-year-old widow loses half her savings to fake David Attenborough scam
Australian MP Helen Haines discharged from hospital a month after losing both legs in car attack
stories.summary: Helen Haines, the Australian lawmaker, was discharged from hospital after critical injuries from an incident last month. She expressed gratitude for the care received during her treatment and the ongoing support from people worldwide. The incident on October 19 left her with severe injuries, leading to the amputation of both legs. Contributions to Save the Children have exceeded 1.4 million Australian dollars as per her family's request.

stories.title: Bilkis Bano gang-rape and murder case: SC suspends life sentence of two convicts, grants bail
'We will find you': Iran's stern warning to US navy officers for Minab school strike
stories.summary: Iran has publicly threatened two US navy officers it accused of directing a February 28 Tomahawk missile strike on an elementary school in Minab that killed 168 children. The Iranian Embassy in South Africa posted their photographs on X with the warning, "We will find you". The threat comes amid escalating tensions between Tehran and Washington over security threats.

stories.title: 'Show some respect': SC pulls up Centre over shifting of 135-year-old Central Secretariat Library in Delhi
Opening Of Ann Francis Padlock: X-ray scans reveal ANCE code; meaning still unknown
stories.summary: After four centuries, the 16th-century brass lock from the Ann Francis shipwreck has finally been unlocked. Utilizing cutting-edge micro-CT scanning technology, researchers deciphered the combination as ANCE. This remarkable find is part of a treasure trove uncovered on Margam Beach in South Wales. Though the letters' meaning remains a mystery, the padlock is now proudly exhibited at the National Waterfront Museum, highlighting its importance in maritime history.

stories.title: Birds battling jet lag: Manx shearwaters suffer jet lag impacting homeward flights; could lead to serious consequences for inexperienced navigators
stories.summary: Recent research highlights that Manx shearwaters returning from foraging encounters navigational challenges akin to human jet lag. Prolonged flights disrupt their internal clocks, causing misalignment with the local time, which results in notable directional inaccuracies, particularly among novice birds. Analysis of two decades of GPS data from over 1,000 nesting shearwaters underscores these findings. Further investigation is required to assess how this temporal discrepancy may affect additional behaviors.

stories.title: 'These your Chhath preparations, Yogi?' AAP shares video of dead cow floating in Kanpur canal as devotees offer prayers - watch
124-year-old handwritten deed sparks oil and gas ownership battle in US; court rules descendants get just one-sixteenth share
stories.summary: A handwritten property deed from 1902 became the center of a legal dispute over mineral rights. The Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia upheld an appellate ruling regarding the deed's interpretation. The case involved claims to ownership of oil and gas beneath a 117.55-acre property. The court concluded that the Severin family retained one-sixteenth of the oil and gas rights, not one-half.

stories.title: BJP lodges complaint after Italian leader's 'vote chor' remark at Congress-led Summit
stories.summary: The BJP has lodged a complaint with the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) in Hyderabad over alleged interference in India's internal affairs by foreign political representatives at the Congress-organised Bharat Summit 2026. Telangana BJP president N Ramchander Rao accused Italian politician Giacomo Filibeck of making provocative remarks in support of the Congress. Filibeck had criticised India's democratic situation and called for international support for Rahul Gandhi, drawing criticism from the BJP and Italian lawmakers.

stories.title: Michigan man claims lottery prize nearly a year after the win
stories.summary: A 68-year-old man from Macomb County won $500,000 while playing the Michigan Lottery's 25 Days of Winning game. This large prize stemmed from a family Christmas tradition where lottery tickets were given as gifts. Initially believing he won only $500, a scan revealed the true amount of $500,000. The winning ticket was purchased at M & H Petro LLC in Clinton Township.

stories.title: 'Hand of unity' vs 'unhinged incitement': Likud, Eisenkot trade barbs over Netanyahu's offer
Ohio man, 78, visits all 50 US state fairs in retirement, with 19 still to go
stories.summary: At the age of 75, Jim Chew was ready for new adventures after retirement. With 31 state fairs already visited, he set a goal to explore all 50 by 2030. Each fair offers him a taste of local culture, foods, and a chance to connect with diverse communities. Jim's organized excursions aim to enrich his journey across the nation, filling his days with exciting experiences instead of monotony.

stories.title: After 100 years of extinction, baby oysters found in Scottish estuary; 140,000 adults returned over 12 years
stories.summary: After more than 100 years, scientists found young European flat oysters in Dornoch Firth, indicating successful natural breeding and conservation. The project aimed to restore native oyster populations through the introduction of adult oysters, totaling around 140,000, over 12 years. Restoration efforts have shown progress as oysters are now reproducing naturally in their habitat. The project supports marine biodiversity by enhancing ecosystems through oyster reef formation.

stories.title: Over 28 cyclists carry Thanksgiving turkeys on their bikes in Maine; unusual ride helps 58 families get free holiday dinners
stories.summary: More than 28 cyclists participated in the eighth annual Turkey Ride to deliver Thanksgiving turkeys. They gathered at Maine Sport Rockport and picked up items from Hannaford Supermarkets. After collecting donations, they transported the groceries to the Camden Area Christian Food Pantry. Fifty-eight families benefited from the food pantry's effort, receiving turkeys for their Thanksgiving meals. The event highlighted community support for those in need and encouraged charitable involvement.

stories.title: 'Insult to faith': BJP shares video of Congress leader Devendra Yadav throwing plastic bottle in Yamuna
stories.summary: BJP condemned Congress party leader Devendra Yadav for allegedly polluting the Yamuna River during Chhath Puja. The BJP accused Congress of disrespecting the faith of Chhath devotees amidst environmental concerns. Cleaning efforts are underway as pollution in the Yamuna raises public health issues ahead of the festival. Authorities are preparing designated ghats for devotees while addressing river pollution.

stories.title: ‘Does Bengal belong to Bengalis or rogue Biharis?’ TMC MP Kalyan Banerjee's remarks on Chhath spark row
stories.summary: A political controversy has emerged in West Bengal over Chhath Puja preparations, led by TMC MP Kalyan Banerjee's statements. Banerjee alleged that the state was being dominated by non-Bengalis and accused the BJP government of neglecting Bengali culture. West Bengal minister Indranil Khan and Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari defended the arrangements for Chhath Puja and rejected claims of cultural appropriation.

stories.title: 'Not AI, this is Yamuna': AAP, BJP lock horns over Chhath celebrations in Delhi 'amid toxic foam'
stories.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) accused the BJP governments in Delhi and at the Centre of making false claims about cleaning the Yamuna as Purvanchali devotees celebrated Chhath Puja at its ghats. Citing toxic foam in the river, AAP targeted Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, while the BJP defended its clean-up efforts and hit back at the previous AAP government.

stories.title: 'Inappropriate to lecture India on democracy': Meloni ally hits back at Italian leader's BJP vote theft jibe
stories.summary: Deborah Bergamini has expressed discontent over Giacomo Filibeck's remarks on India’s electoral process. She emphasized that India has its own political institutions to handle such disputes. Filibeck’s comments occurred during the Bharat Summit 2026, where he supported the Indian Congress Party. The BJP responded by accusing the Congress of seeking foreign interference in national matters. This situation highlights ongoing tensions between Indian political factions regarding electoral integrity and foreign influence.

stories.title: 3 grenades found in polythene bag defused in J&K's Baramulla
stories.summary: Security forces defused three grenades found in a polythene bag in north Kashmir's Baramulla district, as news agency ANI reported Monday. The recovery comes days after police arrested a man and seized two hand grenades from a forest in Tangmarg. Police are investigating the source of the explosives, their intended use and possible links.

stories.title: BJP MP Ajeet Gopchade urges PM Modi to ensure representation of divyang persons in Parliament
stories.summary: Ajeet Gopchade has requested Prime Minister Narendra Modi to develop mechanisms for the representation of divyang persons. He highlighted the successful examples from other countries that facilitate this representation in legislatures. Gopchade suggested that exceptional candidates with disabilities should be considered for Rajya Sabha nominations. The Prime Minister's Office has forwarded his suggestions to relevant ministries for further action.

stories.title: 'Perfectly safe' but not 'maxed out'? Trump takes Qatar jet to Asia
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump is set to travel to Asia on Monday aboard the aircraft gifted by Qatar, even as questions remain over its promised security upgrades. According to NBC News, the jet has received some maintenance and cosmetic improvements, but the larger overhaul remains unclear months after an Iran-related security scare forced Trump to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane.

No fresh trial for Hasina in case for which she got death: Prosecutor

Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites as ULA's Vulcan rocket fails minutes after launch
stories.summary: Amazon's planned launch of 40 satellites for its Leo internet network failed after the Vulcan rocket malfunctioned. The Vulcan rocket, operated by United Launch Alliance, experienced an anomaly 10 minutes after liftoff. This failure poses a setback for Amazon's satellite internet plans, which aim to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. Amazon has also invested in other launch options including Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket and Arianespace.

stories.title: 'Not Cuba or Venezuela': Iran warns it will not wait for US attack before responding
stories.summary: Iran has expressed that it is ready for potential military action while discussing diplomatic avenues with the United States. Deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi indicated three possible scenarios: diplomatic talks, economic blockades, and military response. Tehran has set specific conditions, including ending the war and lifting economic sanctions for any agreement. The arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt in the Middle East adds to ongoing regional tensions.

stories.title: Colorado jury awards $65 million, after mother killed in crash
stories.summary: A jury in Colorado awarded $65 million to the family of Megan Arneson, who was killed in 2022. Arneson died when a truck carrying an improperly loaded excavator struck an I-25 overpass. Her 10-year-old son, who was in the vehicle, witnessed the tragic incident. The truck driver and the company both bore responsibility for the accident in the court's findings.

stories.title: Palm Beach estate tied to foreclosure suit asks $32 million
stories.summary: A mansion located at 301 Plantation Road in Palm Beach is currently listed for sale at $32 million. The property has a history of foreclosure proceedings after the seller defaulted on a $22 million mortgage. This brand-new estate features over 9,000 square feet, seven bedrooms, and luxurious amenities like a double infinity-edge pool. A total of 21 luxury deals were signed in Palm Beach County during a recent week.

stories.title: Noose tightens on Bishnoi: Cops seek jail visitor logs, up security for B-town stars
Ray of hope has reached Gadchiroli this Diwali: PM
Those using Form 6 to re-enroll won't be prosecuted: EC to SC
stories.summary: The Election Commission has committed to include every eligible citizen in the electoral rolls during the current process. No legal action will be taken against individuals for re-registering to vote through Form 6. Voters are advised to ensure their names are not listed in other constituencies before applying. Additionally, those previously removed erroneously can submit fresh forms for their names to be reinstated.
